paper: FinCon: A Synthesized LLM Multi-Agent System with Conceptual Verbal Reinforcement for Enhanced Financial Decision Making
headline_mechanism: FinCon coordinates specialized analysts through one manager, monitors within-episode downside with CVaR, and updates manager/analyst beliefs across episodes through conceptual verbal reinforcement.

source_anchors.claim: Specialized analysts distill multimodal inputs and the manager alone synthesizes their perspectives into trading decisions.
A deterioration in the average worst 1% PnL triggers risk-averse manager reflection.
Profitable versus losing episodes update conceptual investment beliefs and selectively propagate guidance to relevant analysts.
Working, procedural, and episodic memories preserve observations, decisions, outcomes, and updated beliefs.

preserved_elements: specialized market, fundamental, attention, and risk analyst scores
procedural memory of trailing analyst effectiveness
episodic belief updates from profitable and losing historical outcomes
selective belief propagation through changing analyst weights
approximated_elements: JKP characteristic bundles replace price, news, filings, research, and earnings-call audio
trailing analyst RankIC replaces natural-language distilled insights
exponentiated numerical belief updates replace conceptual verbal reinforcement and prompt edits
rolling 5% monthly security CVaR replaces worst-1% daily portfolio PnL CVaR
risk-adjusted score ranking replaces direction-constrained mean-variance portfolio optimization
invented_elements: belief learning rate and softmax update
common value-weighted long/short decile portfolio adapter
portfolio_adapter: The CVaR-adjusted manager score is ranked within the frozen monthly top-1,000 universe and mapped to common value-weighted long/short deciles with 10 bp one-way cost; native mean-variance weights are not used so cross-paper exposure remains comparable.
claim_boundary: This is a researcher-authored FinCon-inspired numerical hierarchy and dual-risk-control policy, not the unavailable GPT-4 manager/analysts, memories, CVRF prompts, multimodal inputs, native optimizer, or paper results.
